youtube_description:
Everyone was expecting Adobe to jump into the AI image generation business, and they did in a big way with Firefly, a system specifically designed for commercial use. 
The Firefly model is trained on stock images for which Adobe already holds the rights, as well as openly licensed and public-domain content. This move by Adobe is significant because generative AI tools and their outputs are still navigating the legal landscape. But with this announcement, Adobe aims to provide clarity and confidence to is creators.
